CSCS-USI Summer School 2026 on Effective High-Performance Computing and Data Analytics
25 - 30 luglio 2026
This CSCS/USI HPC Summer School course will focus on the effective exploitation of state-of-the-art hybrid High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems, with a particular emphasis on Data Analytics. Starting with an introductory overview of the available systems at CSCS, the course will progress to more applied topics, including parallel programming on accelerators, code optimisation, scientific libraries, and deep learning software frameworks.
Further information and content are available on the CSCS-USI Summer University 2026 page.

REAL – Reality Exploration Academy of Locarno 2026
5 – 15 agosto 2026 (durante Locarno Film Festival 79)
REAL – Reality Exploration Academy of Locarno è il programma intensivo organizzato dall'Istituto di Media e Giornalismo (USI) in collaborazione con il Locarno Film Festival. Rivolto a studentesse e studenti universitari appassionati di cinema del reale, REAL combina teoria audiovisiva, pratica creativa, seminari, workshop, masterclass, proiezioni curate e mentorship per la realizzazione di un video essay.
Per studentesse e studenti USI è prevista una formula dedicata, con una quota di partecipazione di 500 CHF anziché 800 CHF. L'iscrizione passa comunque per l'application standard: il percorso di selezione è identico per tutti.
La quota comprende seminari, workshop, masterclass, proiezioni curate, accredito al Festival, conferenza “Future of Cinema”, mentorship per il video essay e certificato ufficiale di partecipazione. Alloggio e colazione non sono inclusi: chi sceglie questa formula organizza il soggiorno in autonomia. Anche i pasti restano a carico dei partecipanti, salvo alcuni eventi specifici comunicati in anticipo.
Le studentesse e gli studenti partecipanti possono ottenere fino a 6 crediti ECTS. Invia la tua candidatura entro il 28 maggio 2026.
Modulo, requisiti e tutti i dettagli: https://www.locarnofestival.ch/it/about/factory/real-academy.html

30th Summer School in Social Sciences Methods
6 – 21 agosto 2026
The Summer School in Social Sciences Methods has been conceived for those who feel the need to refresh, deepen, and broaden their methodological knowledge and skills, whatever their professional situation: student, researcher, or practitioner. This year, once again, we are looking forward to welcoming you for two weeks of learning in August at the beautiful campus of Università della Svizzera italiana in Lugano! The 2026 programme for the 30th-anniversary edition features 3 online statistics workshops and 30 intensive one-week courses tailored for doctoral students, researchers, and practitioners. In addition to its rich academic programme, the School offers a vibrant social programme to help participants connect with one another and experience the best of Lugano. This includes a welcome talk, plenary, followed by a networking aperitivo, and course dinners with fellow participants and course instructors. The social programme is designed to foster a sense of community and make the Summer School experience even more rewarding.
For more information and to register, visit https://www.ssm.usi.ch/en

SIESTA 2026 – 6th International Software Engineering Summer School
2-4 settembre 2026
The Software Institute is pleased to announce SIESTA 2026, the sixth International Software Engineering Summer School, which will take place in Madrid, Spain, on September 2-4, 2026.
The goal of SIESTA is to bring together academic and industrial researchers, along with PhD students, to provide participants with an opportunity to gain firsthand knowledge of recent research trends in Software Engineering. At SIESTA tutorials by leading researchers, student talks, and amazing social events come together to offer our participants the best possible experience. More information

CPS Summer School
21 – 25 settembre 2026
Alghero - Italia

The CPS summer school is targeted at students, research scientists, and R&D experts from academia and industry, who want to learn about CPS engineering and applications. The program will cover all the design phases of CPSs, starting from the conception of the idea down to the definition of the final system and will discuss the key challenges (including adaptivity support, modelling and security) presenting state-of-the-art tools and methods and allowing participants to play with industrial and academic design environments.

Topics of interest include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Market trends for CPS
  • Hardware/software and multi-view modelling
  • Adaptivity
  • Low power design of heterogeneous systems
  • Tools for dataflow design, high-level synthesis, hardware/software co-design, and coarse/fine reconfiguration

For more information and to register, visit https://www.cpsschool.eu/

Summer School: The Aim and Structure of Cosmological Theory
23 - 27 giugno 2025
A number of challenging questions arise in contemporary cosmology, and philosophers can contribute constructively to answering them. In what sense is cosmology a “special case,” in terms of its aims, the nature of cosmological theories, or the ability to establish theories empirically? What, if anything, constrains theorizing about the early universe or regions of space and time that are beyond our observational ken? These and other questions will be tackled at the summer school, whose organizing theme is the forthcoming book by Smeenk & Weatherall The Aim and Structure of Cosmological Theory.
For more information and to register visit www.usi.ch/en/cosmology

PhD Summer School on Finance and Product Markets
30 June – 4 July 2025
Prof. Laurent Frésard (USI & Swiss Finance Institute), Prof. Gordon Phillips (Dartmouth College)
This in-person summer school explores the intersection between finance and industrial organization, focusing on how firms’ financial decisions interact with their product market environments. Through ten intensive sessions, participants will study foundational theories, discuss empirical strategies, and engage in hands-on coding tutorials using Python. Highlights include sessions on causal inference and computational linguistics for market boundary analysis. The course also features a research mini-seminar where participants present their work and receive feedback. Designed for advanced PhD students and researchers in corporate finance and IO, the course encourages active participation and close interaction with faculty and peers. More Information.

CSCS-USI Summer University 2025 on Effective High-Performance Computing and Data Analytics
19-25 July 2025
This summer school will focus on the effective exploitation of state-of-the-art hybrid High-Performance Computing (HPC) systems with a special focus on Data Analytics. The content of the course is tailored for intermediate graduate students (3rd year Bachelor's students, Master’s students, and Ph.D students) interested in both learning parallel programming models, and having hands-on experience using HPC systems. Starting from an introductory explanation of the available systems at CSCS, the course will progress to more applied topics such as parallel programming on accelerators, code optimization, scientific libraries, and deep learning software frameworks.
Additional information on the official website.

REAL Academy – Reality Exploration Academy of Locarno
6 – 16 Agosto 2025
REAL – Reality Exploration Academy of Locarno - is a ten-day program that brings together cutting-edge audiovisual research and creative practices to explore how reality is represented, questioned, and reimagined on screen. At the crossroads of theory and industry, it offers a unique space for dialogue between scholars and filmmakers, inviting participants to reflect critically on the power and responsibility of filming the real.
REAL builds on the legacy of the successful Documentary Summer School after 25 editions with a new reimagined format for the 26th, designed to challenge perspectives and propose new ways to navigate the evolving landscape of non-fiction media. For more information and to register: https://www.locarnofestival.ch/about/factory/real-academy.html

34th Lugano Summer School in Public Health
18 – 23 Agosto 2025
In the 34th edition of the SSPH+ Lugano Summer School in Public Health Policy, Economics, and Management (LSS), practitioners, researchers, and graduate students will come together from all over the world for a unique learning experience focused on public health impact. The seasonal school is a long-term collaboration between the Swiss School of Public Health (SSPH+), USI, SUPSI, and Swiss TPH and places health, disease, and health systems thinking under one common framework of coherent concepts and practical implications. The education obtained and networks created serve as an opportunity to reduce and prevent the gap between public health theory and practice.
Registration is open until July 15. For further information about the available courses and general programme: https://www.ssph-lugano-summerschool.ch/
Special discounts are available for USI students and employees. If you have any further question, you can contact us at info@ssph-lugano-summerschool.ch

ICTs and the Challenges of “Overtourism”: Exploring the Case of Machupicchu
21 – 28 Agosto 2025
The 2025 edition of USI UNESCO Chair Summer School is organized in collaboration with the UNESCO Chair in Anthropology of Health, Biosphere and Healing Systems of the University of Genoa (Italy), the UNESCO Chair on City, Landscape and Heritage of the University of Lima (Peru), the UNESCO Chair on Cultural Heritage and Sustainable Tourism of the University San Martin de Porres (Lima, Peru) and is supported by the UNESCO office in Lima.

Through the research efforts of four UNESCO Chairs and a transdisciplinary approach, participants will engage with key topics such as heritage conservation and management, sustainable interventions to address overtourism affecting the site of Machupicchu, the intangible heritage of Andean ethnomedicine and textile production. Additionally, they will examine how Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs) can support and enhance these processes.
For more inforamtion and to register: https://www.unescochair.usi.ch/summer-school-2025-peru
